Based on the retrieved excerpts, **clause 8.1.4** applies to this bandsaw procurement.

This clause specifically addresses procurement processes that must be established to **"ensure purchased products and services conform to the OH&S management system"** — which directly matches your scenario of buying a machine that needs to arrive conforming to your OH&S requirements.

The other elements in 8.1.4 (contractor activities, outsourced functions) don't apply to your situation as you've confirmed no outside workers or outsourcing is involved. The core requirement for ensuring purchased **products** conform to your OH&S system remains relevant.
